scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @openshelf/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply openshelf --local

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Required secret. Base64 of exactly 32 random bytes; encrypts stored integration credentials. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Required secret. One-time token you type at /admin/setup to create the first owner account. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 24

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for bot protection. Leave empty to disable.

ALLOW_MOCK.description: Optional. Leave empty/unset on production. Set to "true" only on staging/demo to let the owner enable Mock mode (fake payments/SMS/email); it is still refused while a real payment provider is enabled.

DB.description: D1 database for products, orders and settings (created automatically).
